Name: Change Cabin Type (Redux)
Author: Denveous
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=6]Easily change the type of your cabins in Stardew Valley by pressing the configurable hotkey. ([i]default: U[/i])[/size][/font][size=5]
[font=Arial]
[font=Georgia][b]Update Features[/b]:
[/font][/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4] Being able to change any building type (Greenhouse, Shops, etc) has been fixed, you can now only change Cabins so you don't damage your town/farm.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4] When using the original mod on the newer client it would create "extra" buildings, this has been patched.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4] Newer building types have been added to the list.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=5][font=Georgia]
[b]How to Install:
[/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Install SMAPI: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Place the "ChangeCabinType" folder inside the "Mods" folder in your Stardew Valley game directory.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Launch the game via "StardewModdingAPI.exe" and enjoy.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][size=5][font=Georgia][b]How to Use:
[/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Mouse over any cabin (except the main farm house)[/size]
[*][size=4]Press the hotkey (default is U), it will cycle through the list of available building types.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][font=Georgia][b]Settings:
[/b][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Edit the "config.json" file in the "ChangeCabinType" folder to set your options.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[/size][size=4][b]The original mod can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3046]here[/url]﻿[i], and the source can be found [/i][/b][url=https://github.com/Denveous/ChangeCabinTypeRedux/][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url].[i]

[font=Comic Sans MS]Credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57696216]funnysnek[/url] (original code/idea), blueberry & shekurika from the SDV discord for assisting me sort out some issues migrating the code (Thank you).[/font][/i][/size]
